title: ARES scholarships for international training programmes (Belgium)
organization: ARES (Academie de recherche et d'enseignement superieur), Wallonia-Brussels Federation
overview: ARES (Belgium) scholarships for short international trainings of 12 months at most: a specialisation bachelor in Digital Integrated Supply Chain, eight specialised masters (including International and Development Economics and Advanced Master in Microfinance) and a cybersecurity certificate, for professionals living and working in 32 partner countries, the DRC included. The 2027-2028 call closed on 18 September 2026; the next call is announced for August 2027.
program_dates: 2027-2028 academic year for the call that just closed
deadline_text: ARES page: 'Date limite : Vendredi 18 septembre 2026'; 'L'appel bourses 2027-2028 est clôturé.'; 'Prochain appel : Aout 2027.' The application form reads 'Ce formulaire est clos aux nouvelles soumissions.'
expected_next_cycle: The ARES page states 'Prochain appel : Aout 2027.' No closing date for it is given.
funding_details: 'La bourse comprend': international travel costs; a subsistence allowance; exceptional visa costs (specialisation bachelor and specialised masters only); registration fees (specialisation bachelor and specialised masters only); indirect mission costs (continuing training only); insurance costs
The page does not use the words 'fully funded' and gives no allowance amount
Duration: specialisation bachelor and specialised masters 12 months at most; continuing training 6 months at most
eligibility: Permanent resident and working in one of the 32 eligible countries (the DRC, 'RD Congo', is on the list; Palestinian nationals are eligible wherever they live)
Holder of a higher-education diploma that meets the admission conditions of the chosen training; the relevant academic degree obtained no more than 20 years before the training starts
At least two years of relevant professional occupation in an eligible country after the last higher-education diploma and before the call closes
File completed in the language of instruction, with good written and spoken knowledge of it; some French helps daily life in Belgium
nationality_requirements: Permanent residence and work in one of 32 partner countries; the DRC ('RD Congo') is among the 21 African countries named
education_requirement: Higher-education diploma meeting the training's admission conditions; relevant degree not older than 20 years
experience_requirement: At least two years of relevant professional occupation after the last higher-education diploma, in an eligible country, before the call closes
language_requirement: Good written and spoken knowledge of the language of instruction; a minimum of French is advised
application_process: Online form on form.ares-ac.be during the call window

action: Nothing to do now: the 2027-2028 call is closed and the next one is announced for August 2027.
